name: daisyUI 5
description: daisyUI 5.7.50's look (pill buttons with a press-down translate, soft rounded-box cards and modals, chunky squircle-thumb toggles, tabs-box segmented controls, soft-tint badges and alerts, the SVG-mask loading ring) translated onto the t-* vocabulary, every colour read from --t-* tokens.
notes: Not vendored: daisyUI 5 is a Tailwind 4 CSS plugin whose component classes (btn, badge, modal-box…) cannot be demanded from read-only tailor markup (contract rule 5), and its colours are OKLCH --color-* theme tokens. The relevant declarations from its built CSS were re-expressed against t-* selectors; base-100→canvas, base-200→inset/selection, base-300→border, base-content→text, primary→accent, neutral→overlay-bg. Muted text uses daisy's trick of color-mix'ing base-content at 45–60 % instead of a second palette colour.
